__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus (HVM host exporters)
__inputs.description: Prometheus that scrapes node_exporter and prometheus-libvirt-exporter on the HVM hosts

title: HVM Bottlenecks
description: Where HVM hosts and VMs wait: CPU, memory, disk and network

panels.title: CPU pressure (PSI some)
panels.description: Share of time at least one task on the host waited for a CPU. Short spikes are normal; a level that stays above roughly 10-20 % means the host is CPU bound.

targets.expr: 100 * rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: 5 minute load average divided by logical CPUs. Above 1 for long periods: more runnable work than CPUs.

targets.expr: (node_load5{instance=~"$instance"} / on (instance) count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", instance=~"$instance"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by vCPU wait %
panels.description: Time the vCPUs of a VM were ready to run but waited for a physical CPU, per vCPU. A few percent is noticeable inside the guest; this is the first sign of CPU overcommit.

targets.expr: topk(10, (100 * sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) / on (instance, domain) libvirt_domain_info_virtual_cpus{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

panels.title: vCPU wait % now
panels.description: Current vCPU wait per VM, highest first.

targets.expr: topk(15, (100 * sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) / on (instance, domain) libvirt_domain_info_virtual_cpus{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)
topk(15, 100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

panels.title: Memory pressure (PSI)
panels.description: some: at least one task waited for memory (reclaim, swap-in). full: all tasks waited at the same time. Any sustained non-zero 'full' value needs attention.

targets.expr: 100 * rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info
100 * rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info
100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Host swap used
panels.description: Swap in use on the host. Growth here while PSI memory rises means the host is short of memory.

targets.expr: (node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by swap in/out
panels.description: Guest swap traffic reported by the balloon driver.

targets.expr: topk(10, ((rate(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_in_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_in_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_in_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_in_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))) + (rate(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_out_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_out_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_out_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_swap_out_bytes{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by major page faults
panels.description: Page faults inside the guest that needed disk I/O. A lasting rise means the guest is short of memory.

targets.expr: topk(10, ((rate(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_major_fault_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_major_fault_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_major_fault_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_memory_stats_major_fault_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

panels.title: I/O pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time tasks waited for I/O. Rising 'full' means the storage path is the bottleneck.

targets.expr: 100 * rate(node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info
100 * rate(node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Host disk busy %
panels.description: Busiest physical disk of each host: share of time with I/O in flight. Near 100 % on a single disk means it is saturated (less meaningful for SSD and arrays that serve requests in parallel).

targets.expr: max by (instance) (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Host disk latency
panels.description: Average time per completed request on the host disks.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

(sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by write latency
panels.description: Average time per write request seen by the VM.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) / sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by IOPS (noisy neighbours)
panels.description: VMs issuing the most write requests. When latency rises for everyone, start here.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

panels.title: Host interface drops
panels.description: Packets dropped per second (receive + transmit) per host interface.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"lo|vnet.*|veth.*|tap.*|virbr.*|docker.*|br-.*|ovs.*|genev_sys.*|vxlan.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"lo|vnet.*|veth.*|tap.*|virbr.*|docker.*|br-.*|ovs.*|genev_sys.*|vxlan.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Host interface errors
panels.description: Receive and transmit errors per second. Should stay at zero.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"lo|vnet.*|veth.*|tap.*|virbr.*|docker.*|br-.*|ovs.*|genev_sys.*|vxlan.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{instance=~"$instance", device!~"lo|vnet.*|veth.*|tap.*|virbr.*|docker.*|br-.*|ovs.*|genev_sys.*|vxlan.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by dropped packets
panels.description: Drops on the VM tap interfaces.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))) + (rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_drops_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

topk(10, (sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)

topk(10, (sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info)
